purpose: Separate corpus availability, retrieval, structural recognition/witness construction, and target transfer; test whether contrastive near-misses and cross-analogy confirmation improve failure localization without creating authority leakage.
blocking_invariants: hidden target identifiers and answer labels are unavailable to the retriever and mapper
surface-near-miss negatives cannot be omitted from recognition evaluation
cross-analogy confirmation may strengthen a structural search hypothesis but cannot mint target-domain authority
domain diversity cannot compensate for weak or missing mapping witnesses
negative and refuted analogy history remains preserved

worlds.setup: The designated deep analogue is not present in the frozen candidate corpus.
The designated far-domain analogue is present in the frozen corpus but absent from the retrieved top-k set.
The designated analogue is retrieved, but the mapper fails to construct the frozen structural witness.
The designated analogue is retrieved and correctly witnessed, but a target-only constraint refutes the proposed intervention.
Lexical and embedding views miss a distant analogue while a domain-stripped relational view retrieves it.
A surface neighbor ranks above the deep analogue, but the deep analogue remains inside top-k.
A near-miss shares terminology and roles but reverses a decisive causal edge.
One positive analogue and one structurally close near-miss differ only on a registered invariant needed for transfer.
Two distant source domains independently preserve the same registered relational invariant with different surface realizations.
Two retrieved candidates appear mutually confirming only because both share the same surface vocabulary while their causal structures disagree with the target.
All high-ranked analogies come from one familiar domain despite equally witnessed candidates in several distant domains.
The retrieval or mapping process is given the frozen correct-candidate identifier or relevance label.
The search query or abstraction is modified after inspecting hidden relevance labels or the answer key.

required_controls: hidden relevance labels withheld until scoring

promotion_rule: No active retrieval, analogy-ranking, witness-construction, or transfer behavior may be promoted from Round 014 unless this frozen packet is executed on the exact candidate subject. Query templates, top-k, hidden labels, acceptance criteria and stage definitions may not be changed after result inspection.
